issues: Persistent React hydration warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Same cosmetic warning tracked since iter167 (Tailwind [&_option] utility). Not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:432-458 CORS block — implementation is correct: no allow_origin_regex, allow_credentials true only when non-wildcard, www variant auto-added. Preview host is inside CORS_ORIGINS. ✓

server.py:437 rstrip('/') on every configured origin is good defensive parsing; consider also lower-casing hostnames to match browser normalisation (browsers send Origin lower-case anyway, but env values may be mixed case).
whatsapp_link.py campaign_list — response fields delivered/read/booked are always integers (test asserts isinstance int) and 0-defaults when gateway has no data yet. ✓
WaCampaignBits.jsx CampaignHistory — row text uses raw '·' separators; consider adding aria-labels ('1 read, 1 delivered, 0 booked') for screen readers.

Login.jsx:96-101 auto-registerPasskey on every successful login attempts to register a passkey silently. On shared/kiosk machines this is undesirable — the pk_declined guard only kicks in AFTER first prompt cancellation. Consider requiring an explicit opt-in from Settings instead of an auto-prompt.

LoginShowcase.jsx renders two large hero assets (hero-salon.jpg, dining.jpg) inside the unauth Login route — this increases first-paint payload for logged-out users; consider `loading="lazy"` + width/height or convert to CSS-background with responsive sizes.
